<!-- pr-reviewer: 4cd8bdae27cd74cd2c7f59f2a3417e031faa6e9d -->
Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: six blocking findings.

The local trial merge with upstream/main (`7f2d9bfc4efe40dbf12e06c93f2675896814925b`) succeeded. No GitHub runner was used.

The registration, machine parsing, basic milling output, and named refusal tests passed. The changed files do not include UI code, dependencies, or process files.

Validation:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: completed; used to inspect the test selection.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo test -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- 26 targeted suites: 196 tests passed, zero failed.
- Post suites: `hurco_winmax_post` (8), `script_hurco_winmax` (11), `script_grbl` (11), `grbl_dialect` (2), `bore_cycle` (9), `comment_escape` (3), `comp` (9), `comp_plane` (3), `decimal_point_fanuc_family` (3), `declared_options` (3), `end_units` (3), `expanded_bore_refusal` (5), `fanuc_post` (12), `first_traverse_clearance` (9), `first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family` (9), `radius_arcs` (7).
- App suites: `hurco_winmax_post` (2), `conformance` (7), `machine` (33), `machine_library` (11), `post_spindle_rule_all` (5), `after_op` (10), `bore_cycle` (4), `control_comp` (5), `program_units` (7), `wear_comp` (5).
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Reviewed every added NC golden and refusal file for both posts, line by line. The Hurco probe golden contains findings 1–3 below.
- Re-ran two claimed mutations through the local `post` CLI. Temporary script copies and checks stayed outside the repository. Removing the `rigidTapping === false` guard made the refusal assertion RED. The original script made it GREEN. Bypassing `tiltOk()` made the rotary refusal assertion RED. The original script made it GREEN. No PR file was changed.
- Additional CLI checks posted the recorded probe stream in mm and inch, a left-hand floating tap, and tapping cycles with dwell.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P1] Fix the missed-contact test.** `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps:923` compares the trip register with `ExpectX/Y/Z`, not the commanded travel limit. The recorded stream commands X43 and expects contact at X38. With no contact, #5061 is 43 and the condition jumps past the alarm. Contact exactly at X38 raises the alarm. If all four touches miss, their means are still X30/Y30, so both final tolerance checks pass. The inch program also compares inch registers with the unchanged constants 38 and 22. Test contact status or the travel limit in the active units. Check every touch, including the first touch without a measurement slot. Add tests for a successful nominal contact and a missed contact. [Hurco skip-function documentation](https://support.hurco.com/wp-content/uploads/hurco_mill/NC_Programming/Plane_Selection.htm) states that a missed touch stores the endpoint.

2. **[P1] Alarm after an unexpected trip during a protected move.** `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps:937` writes a bare G31 for `GUARD`. It does not check whether the probe reached the endpoint. In the recorded program, the Z25 guard is followed directly by the Z15 guard and then an X touch. A trip on a clamp during the first descent does not stop the program. Add an alarm check before any later motion. Pin a guard that reaches its target and a guard that trips early. This must meet the existing `GuardRec` contract in `crates/post/src/post/probe_rec.rs`.

3. **[P1] Use Hurco work-offset registers.** `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps:986` selects Fanuc registers with `5201 + wcsIndex * 20`. The golden writes `G10 L2 P2 X[#5221+#190] Y[#5222+#191]`. Hurco documents X offsets in #2501–#2599, Y offsets in #2601–#2699, and Z offsets in #2701–#2799. The current source offset is therefore not read from its documented register. Correct the axis-specific register mapping. Check a nonzero source offset, a different target offset, and an auxiliary source offset. Update the probe golden. See the [Hurco NCPP variable table](https://support.hurco.com/wp-content/uploads/hurco_mill/NC_Programming/NCPP_Variable_Summary.htm).

4. **[P1] Preserve the hand of a floating tap.** `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps:842` always selects G84 for floating tapping. A stream with `MillSpindle reverse` and `CYCLE FLOATINGTAP` posts `S1000 M4` followed by `G99 G84 ...`, without a warning. Hurco defines G84 as clockwise tapping and G74 as left-handed tapping. Select the documented left-hand cycle or refuse that combination by name. Add both hands to the tests and word validation. See [Hurco tapping cycles](https://support.hurco.com/wp-content/uploads/hurco_mill/NC_Programming/Special_Program_Support.htm).

5. **[P2] Accept documented tapping dwell.** `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps:838` and `:844` reject every positive dwell for G84 and G84.2/G84.3. Hurco lists P dwell in all three cycle formats. The CLI reproduces both refusals with a 0.5-second dwell. Write the documented decimal-second P word and add positive tests. Correct the contrary statement in the decision record and PR body. The [Hurco cycle reference](https://support.hurco.com/wp-content/uploads/hurco_mill/NC_Programming/Special_Program_Support.htm) describes these parameters.

6. **[P2] Supply the required WinMax simulator results.** `docs/decisions/2573-hurco-winmax-post.md:50` states that these checks were not done. Issue #2573 explicitly requires short programs checked in the owner's WinMax simulator, with results on the issue. Record the load result and path comparison for each requested control question. The word allowlist and self-generated goldens do not satisfy that acceptance item.

The full workspace, release lanes, and physical control were not tested. The PR remains a draft and receives `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Replaced by #2646: the same Hurco commit on a branch straight off main, so it no longer waits for the Grbl draft #2506. This PR can be closed.
